final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.product_color AS col, SUM(CAST(l.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS q FROM Invoice_Line_Items l JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), t AS (SELECT col, q, q * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(q) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(q) FROM c) AS av FROM c) SELECT AVG(q) AS avg_quantity, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(q - av) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE q > av
